v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Ámplius lava me, * Dómine, ab iniustítia mea.
text.en: O Lord, wash me * yet more from my iniquity.
O Lord, * thou wilt pardon our transgressions.

text.la: In innocéntia * cordis mei perambulábo, Dómine.
text.en: I walked in the innocence * of my heart, O Lord.

text.la: Exsultávit cor meum * in Dómino, qui humíliat et súblevat.
text.en: My heart hath rejoiced * in the Lord, he humbleth and he exalteth.

text.la: Lauda * ánima mea Dóminum, qui érigit elísos et díligit iustos.
text.en: Praise * the Lord my soul, he lifts up those who fall, and loves the just.

text.la: Nox præcéssit, dies autem appropinquávit. Abiciámus ergo ópera tenebrárum, et induámur arma lucis. Sicut in die honéste ambulémus.
text.en: The night is passed, and the day is at hand. Let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and put on the armour of light. Let us walk honestly, as in the day.

v.en: We are filled in the morning with thy mercy.

r.en: And we have rejoiced, and are delighted.

text.la: De manu ómnium * qui odérunt nos, liberávit nos Dóminus.
text.en: From the hand of all * who hate us, the Lord has delivered us.

text.la: Adésto, Dómine, supplicatiónibus nostris: et intercessióne beáti Lauréntii Mártyris tui, cuius prævenímus festivitátem; perpétuam nobis misericórdiam benígnus impénde.
text.en: Attend, O Lord, to our supplications, and by the intercession of Thy blessed martyr, Lawrence, whose feast we anticipate, graciously bestow upon us Thy everlasting mercy.

text.la: Qui odit ánimam suam in hoc mundo, in vitam ætérnam custódit eam.
text.en: He that hateth his life in this world, shall keep it unto life eternal.

v.en: The righteous shall flourish like the palm-tree.

r.en: He shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

text.la: Præsta, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut, intercedénte beáto Románo Mártyre tuo, et a cunctis adversitátibus liberémur in córpore, et a pravis cogitatiónibus mundémur in mente.
text.en: Graciously hear us, we beseech thee, O Almighty God, and, at the petition of thy blessed Martyr, Romanus be mercifully pleased to deliver us from all things which may hurt our bodies, and from all evil thoughts which may defile our souls.
